text: Dewesoft is fully owned by its employees: the company describes itself as 100% employee-owned, free from external investors and acquisitions.

source.name: Dewesoft – Why work with us (dewesoft.com/about-us)
source.quote: Our company is fully owned by our employees, ensuring complete independence and long-term stability. Free from external investors and acquisitions
source.note: The page's own heading for this section is '100% Employee-Owned'. The page carries no publication date; the date given is the date the page was opened.
